calls.bash: mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --worktree --task rt2 --send 'do rt2; end with the CLOSE/REPORT block' --json

EV=$(mu agent wait w1 -w eval --after-runs 0 --json --timeout 120 | jq -r '(.data.agents // .agents)[0].lastText' | sed -n 's/^CLOSE: task=rt2 evidence="\(.*\)"$/\1/p'); echo "evidence: $EV"; test -n "$EV" && mu task close rt2 -w eval --evidence "$EV"

text: rt2 closed with the worker's evidence and merged.
